spec.description: Merlin 7 nodes and services status and utilization.

options.content:
📢
Scheduled Maintenance

Merlin7 will undergo scheduled maintenance on Tuesday, 27 October 2026, starting at 07:00 am. The cluster will be unavailable during this period.

The maintenance will cover the AFS decommissioning and Pmodules migration to NFS, and node upgrades.

A Slurm maintenance reservation has already been configured. Please ensure that your jobs request an appropriate walltime (--time) to complete before the maintenance begins. Jobs that cannot finish before the reservation may remain pending until the cluster is available again.

We will notify you once the maintenance is complete.
